action.content: Write a funny poem for kids about a product that you would like to sell. The poem should have exactly 6 stanzas. Separated the stanzas using 3 asterisk markers: ***
action.label: context

action.content:
Meet the Gloop-Goo, the sticky best friend,
That turns your messy room into a grand, sticky blend.
You drop a spoon of Gloop-Goo on the floor,
And suddenly, your toys are stuck to the floor!

***

Your socks will float away like tiny white balloons,
While your cereal bowl becomes a slippery, gooey pool.
You try to run, but your feet won't move a inch,
Because the Gloop-Goo has turned your whole body into a mushy pinch!

***

Your mom will scream, "What have you done today?"
As she tries to pull a clean shirt from the gray,
But the Gloop-Goo holds it tight with a sticky, sweet embrace,
Making laundry day the most painful, gooey race!

***

But wait! There's a special way to make it go away,
Just sprinkle some Sparkle-Spray right on the day!
*Puff, puff, puff* goes the magic air,
And the Gloop-Goo vanishes with a happy, fizzy care!

***

So buy the Gloop-Goo if you love a big, sticky mess,
Or buy the Sparkle-Spray to make the chaos less!
It's the funniest, messiest, gooiest game ever played,
With a little spray and a lot of sticky, sticky, sticky, played!

***

Don't forget to wash your hands before you play,
Or you might end up stuck to the wall all day!
The Gloop-Goo is great for fun and for the fun,
But always use the Spray to make the sticky messes done!
